user.title: Home Heating Control
user.description: General settings. Add rooms (zones) afterwards via “Add zone”.

data.away_eco_heating: Keep heating at ECO temperature when away

data_description.base_temp_entity: Sensor or number with the target room temperature, e.g. from a heating curve. Room offsets are added to it.
data_description.schedule_entity: While the schedule is on, the comfort temperature applies (if someone is home).
data_description.person_entities: If none of them is home, only ECO heating applies.
data_description.frost_threshold: At or below this outdoor temperature heating continues even if ECO heating is off (winter mode only).
data_description.away_eco_heating: Off: nobody home means heating off (except frost protection).
data_description.window_reaction_time: Seconds a window must stay open before heating turns off. 0 = immediately.

areas.title: Create zones from areas
areas.description: One zone is created for each of these areas (areas with thermostats). Comfort offset 0, ECO −3; a window sensor is only set if the area has exactly one. Everything can be changed per zone afterwards.

abort.already_configured: Home Heating Control is already set up.

data.eco_relative: ECO offset in addition to comfort offset

data_description.comfort_offset: Added to the base target temperature, e.g. −1 for the bathroom.
data_description.eco_offset: Applies when away, outside the schedule or with ECO.
data_description.eco_relative: Off: the ECO offset applies directly to the base. On: comfort and ECO offsets are added.
